issues.description: The template's Stock.take method has return type boolean, but the problem UML and the solution expect an int return type (using -1 to indicate failure and a non-negative remaining quantity on success). This mismatch is structural: students implementing SealSaloon (which relies on Stock.take returning int) will face a type/signature conflict and compilation/runtime logic issues if they follow the template's signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template Stock.take method signature to return int (matching the UML and solution). Implement it so it returns -1 when the ingredient is missing or out of stock, and returns the remaining quantity after decrementing on success. Update any template references to match this return convention.
